```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr) # for using %>%
library(lubridate) #For converting .txt to Date format
```
```{r}
birds_data <- read.csv("ALA_PE2S12026.csv")

viz_data <- birds_data %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(observationDate),
    month_num = month(date),
    season = case_when(
      month_num %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Spring",
      month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Summer",
      month_num %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Autumn",
      month_num %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Winter"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(vernacularName, season) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(vernacularName) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count))
```
```{r}
ggplot(viz_data, aes(x = vernacularName, y = proportion, fill = season)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(title = "Seasonal Distribution of Birds", x = "Species", y = "Proportion") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(htmltools)

# --- 1. UI Design ---
ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$div(
    style = "text-align: center; padding: 20px;",
    h1("Endangered Bird Species Analysis in Australia")
  ),
  hr(),
  
  # VIS 1 Section
  fluidRow(
    column(width = 7, plotOutput("seasonalPlot", height = "400px")),
    column(width = 5,
           wellPanel(
             h4("VIS 1: Seasonal Distribution Narrative"),
             p("This 100% stacked bar chart illustrates the proportional seasonal presence of bird species. 
               By using 'Position' as a visual variable on a common scale, we can accurately compare 
               distributions across different species regardless of total observation counts. 
               This helps identify migratory behaviors versus year-round residency.")
           ))
  ),
  hr(),
  
  # MAP Section
  fluidRow(
    column(width = 3, 
           wellPanel(
             h4("Map Controls"),
             uiOutput("species_selector"),
             hr(),
             radioButtons("season_filter", "Select Season:",
                          choices = c("Full Year" = "All", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter", "Spring"),
                          selected = "All")
           )),
    column(width = 9, leafletOutput("map", height = "550px"))
  ),
  
  # MAP Description
  fluidRow(
    column(width = 12,
           wellPanel(
             h4("MAP: Description and Interpretation"),
             p("This interactive map visualizes geographic sighting density across Australia. 
               A key insight is the migration of the Swift Parrot (Lathamus discolor); 
               during Winter, they concentrate in South-Eastern Australia after breeding in Tasmania. 
               The circle radius is scaled to observation counts, identifying critical habitat hotspots.")
           ))
  ),
  
  # --- DATA SOURCE INFORMATION (Left Aligned - Requirement 3) ---
  hr(),
  tags$footer(
    style = "text-align: left; padding: 10px 20px 30px 20px; font-size: 0.95em;",
    p(strong("(Original) Data Source Information")),
    p("Name: Occurrence download of Atlas of Living Australia (ALA)"),
    p("URL: ", a("https://www.ala.org.au/", href="https://www.ala.org.au/", target="_blank")),
    p("Licensor: Atlas of Living Australia (CC BY 4.0)"),
    p("Date of Version: April 2026")
  )
)

# --- 2. Server Logic ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Load and Prepare Data
  raw_data <- reactive({
    tryCatch({
      df <- read.csv("ALA_PE2S12026.csv")
      # Force standardize coordinates names to prevent 'inference' error
      names(df)[tolower(names(df)) == "decimallatitude"] <- "decimalLatitude"
      names(df)[tolower(names(df)) == "decimallongitude"] <- "decimalLongitude"
      
      df %>%
        mutate(
          date = as.Date(observationDate),
          month_num = month(date),
          Season = case_when(
            month_num %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Spring",
            month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2)  ~ "Summer",
            month_num %in% c(3, 4, 5)   ~ "Autumn",
            month_num %in% c(6, 7, 8)   ~ "Winter"
          ),
          Season = factor(Season, levels = c("Summer", "Autumn", "Winter", "Spring"))
        )
    }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  })

  # Dynamic Checklist
  output$species_selector <- renderUI({
    df <- raw_data()
    req(df)
    checkboxGroupInput("species_filter", "Select Bird Species:",
                       choices = unique(df$vernacularName),
                       selected = unique(df$vernacularName))
  })

  # Visualisation 1: Proportional Bar Chart
  output$seasonalPlot <- renderPlot({
    df <- raw_data()
    req(df)
    viz_summary <- df %>%
      group_by(vernacularName, Season) %>%
      summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      group_by(vernacularName) %>%
      mutate(Proportion = count / sum(count))

    ggplot(viz_summary, aes(x = vernacularName, y = Proportion, fill = Season)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
      labs(title = "Proportional Seasonal Distribution", x = "Species", y = "Percentage") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  })

  # Reactive Filter for Map
  filtered_df <- reactive({
    df <- raw_data()
    req(df, input$species_filter)
    
    data <- df %>% dplyr::filter(vernacularName %in% input$species_filter)
    
    if (input$season_filter != "All") {
      data <- data %>% dplyr::filter(Season == input$season_filter)
    }
    
    data %>%
      group_by(decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, scientificName, vernacularName, stateProvince) %>%
      summarise(obs_count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  })

  # Initial Map View
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() %>%
      addTiles() %>%
      setView(lng = 133.9453, lat = -30.4486, zoom = 3)
  })

  # Markers and Legend
  observe({
    data <- filtered_df()
    req(data)
    req(nrow(data) > 0)
    
    bird_pal <- colorFactor(palette = "Dark2", domain = data$vernacularName)
    
    leafletProxy("map", data = data) %>%
      clearMarkers() %>%
      clearControls() %>%
      addCircleMarkers(
        lng = ~decimalLongitude,
        lat = ~decimalLatitude,
        radius = ~pmin(sqrt(obs_count) * 1.5, 20),
        color = ~bird_pal(vernacularName),
        fillOpacity = 0.6,
        stroke = FALSE,
        label = ~paste0("<b>Common:</b> ", vernacularName, 
                        "<br><b>Scientific:</b> ", scientificName,
                        "<br><b>Count:</b> ", obs_count) %>% lapply(htmltools::HTML)
      ) %>%
      addLegend(position = "bottomright", pal = bird_pal, values = ~vernacularName, title = "Species")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
